title: Core Kernel Decoupling
description: Strip model-definition assets and geometry/transformation logic from cad/js/core. Core provides interfaces + registry; assets.ts loads via registerModelDefinitionAssets; kernel implements geometry; transformations are pure data.
summary: Decoupled cad/js/core from model-definition assets and geometry: registry + assets.ts + model-definition-registry.ts load catalogs via registerModelDefinitionAssets; core imports assets at startup. SpatialPreviewKernel extended with topology preview primitives implemented in brepjs. Transformations use declarative derive block (energy from_geometry in JSON); applyTransformation(spec, source, preview) and ModelSpace.transform require preview kernel. defaultModelDefinitionId() and kernelTopologyTypologies from manifest replace hardcoded spatial.shape constants in core logic. All @semio-tech/cad-js-core, @semio-tech/cad-js-kernel-brepjs, and @semio-tech/cad-js-query tests pass.
